notes.title: LEX MORTIS Update v1.1 (A lot of fixes)
notes.notes:
LEX MORTIS Update v1.1 (A lot of fixes)
This is not the end of updates. LEX MORTIS still will receive updates.

Fixed a lot of bugs. 
Reworked saving system. Now it works correct.
Reworked the night, now it will be brighter. 
Added "Skip intro". 
Fixed collision bugs. 
Fixed bug related to playing cutscenes while pressing Z or 2
Fixed "Colored text on the ground"
Fixed inverting mouse by the default.
Fixed bugs related to object occlusion.
Fixed bugs related to the hallucinations.
Added ability to turn off SSAO.
Reworked graphic settings. 
Reworked some effects and other visual components. 
Added new sounds. And a lot more.
